opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for other tuition fee support, must be enrolled in an undergraduate degree at a Scottish HE institution, UK indefinite leave or asylum seeker allowed, not a repeat graduate unless meeting specific criteria.
opportunities.summary: Provides tuition fee support of up to £1,820 per year for eligible undergraduate students covering academic year 2026‑27.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income Scottish households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, graduates applying for a full‑time or part‑time taught master’s programme at a Scottish university for academic year 2026‑27.
opportunities.summary: Financial support of up to £5,000 per year for eligible postgraduate master’s students to cover study costs.
